report.verdict: A senior backend engineer whose payments work comes with scale and measurable results.
write_up: This is a strong senior backend resume! At Lumen Ledger, you show how you built payments infrastructure, migrated the ledger and improved API performance. A recruiter can connect the technical choices to the scale of the work and what changed.

The balance API line is a model: it names the latency problem, the change you made and the before-and-after numbers. The move from insurance to freight technology to payments is easy to follow, and your current role backs up your senior headline.

Your resume isn't likely to be the thing holding you back on its own. Competition for a particular job will still matter. I'd add one concrete detail to the older Northgate role, then consider whether your ledger migration can also show a broader technical decision.

cards.line: Maintained the claims intake services in Java
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter knows which services you worked on, but not what maintaining them involved. One change you made would give them something concrete to take away.
cards.example: Maintained the claims intake services in Java by [changes made]
cards.question: What changes did you make to the claims intake services?

cards.where: Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform, line 3
cards.line: Cut p99 latency on the balance API from 900 ms to 140 ms by moving reads to a Kafka-fed cache
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It gives the reader a precise performance measure and ties it to a technical choice you made.

cards.where: Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform, line 2
cards.line: Led the migration of the ledger from a single Postgres instance to a sharded cluster with zero downtime over six weekends
cards.cannot_tell: For a role above senior engineer, a recruiter will also look for technical direction across teams. If this migration involved a broader architectural decision, your part in it could strengthen the story.
cards.example: Led the migration of the ledger from a single Postgres instance to a sharded cluster with zero downtime over six weekends, with [cross-team architectural decision and your role]
cards.question: Was there a cross-team architectural decision behind the migration, and what was your part in it?

fit.why: Your headline and current payments role point to senior backend work in services, databases and distributed systems.
fit.level: senior, leads a ledger migration and mentors two mid-level engineers
fit.note: Your experience points toward senior backend roles, particularly those involving payments or high-volume services. The freight work also shows you can bring API and event-driven experience beyond payments.
